explanation: A common greeting used when meeting someone.
examples: 你好！很高兴认识你。 (Hello! Nice to meet you.)
老师说：'你好，同学们。' (The teacher said, 'Hello, students.')

explanation: Used to show gratitude when someone helps you or gives you something.
examples: 谢谢你的帮助。 (Thank you for your help.)
我收到礼物后说谢谢。 (I said thank you after receiving the gift.)

explanation: Used when talking about studying, practicing, or learning something new.
examples: 我每天学习汉语。 (I study Mandarin every day.)
学习新词很重要。 (Learning new words is important.)

explanation: Refers to a person you know well and like.
examples: 她是我的好朋友。 (She is my good friend.)
我和朋友一起去公园。 (I go to the park with my friend.)

explanation: Having a meal, whether alone or with others.
examples: 我们下班以后一起去吃饭吧。 (Let’s go eat together after work.)
我今天中午在公司食堂吃饭。 (I ate lunch at the company cafeteria today.)
天气这么热，你要多喝水。 (It’s so hot, you should drink more water.)
我每天早上起床都会先喝水。 (I drink water first thing every morning.)
请问这个手机现在多少钱？ (How much is this phone now?)
这双鞋打折以后是多少钱？ (How much are these shoes after discount?)
我可以在这里坐一会儿吗？ (Can I sit here for a while?)
你今天晚上可以陪我去吗？ (Can you go with me tonight?)
我今天不太饿，所以不要吃饭。 (I’m not very hungry today, so I don’t want to eat.)
你走路的时候不要看手机。 (Don’t look at your phone while walking.)
我现在正在家里看电视节目。 (I am watching TV at home now.)
你现在方便接电话聊天吗？ (Are you free to take a call now?)

explanation: A brief pause or short wait.
examples: 你先别走，等一下我马上回来。 (Don’t leave yet, wait a moment, I’ll be back soon.)
请等一下，我还没准备好出门。 (Please wait a moment, I’m not ready to go out yet.)

explanation: A question about reasons or causes.
examples: 你今天为什么没有来上班呢？ (Why didn’t you come to work today?)
这个东西为什么这么贵呢？ (Why is this item so expensive?)
因为今天下大雨，所以我没出门。 (Because it rained heavily today, I didn’t go out.)
我累了，因为昨天晚上睡得太晚。 (I’m tired because I slept too late last night.)

explanation: Having information or awareness about something.
examples: 我早就知道这件事情的结果了。 (I already knew the result of this matter.)
你知道附近哪里有好吃的吗？ (Do you know where to find good food nearby?)
我觉得这部电影真的很好看。 (I think this movie is really good.)
你觉得我们应该几点出发比较好？ (What time do you think we should leave?)
我很喜欢周末在家休息看书。 (I really like staying home and reading on weekends.)
她特别喜欢喝冰的奶茶。 (She especially likes drinking iced milk tea.)

explanation: A negative preference or lack of enjoyment.
examples: 我不喜欢早上太早起床上班。 (I don’t like waking up too early for work.)
他不喜欢在下雨天出门活动。 (He doesn’t like going out on rainy days.)
我最近工作很忙，经常要加班。 (I’ve been very busy with work and often work overtime.)
她找到了一份离家很近的工作。 (She found a job close to home.)
我今天晚上六点准时下班回家。 (I get off work at six and go home.)
你下班以后想不想一起去吃饭？ (Do you want to eat together after work?)

explanation: Starting the workday or being at work.
examples: 我每天早上八点准时去公司上班。 (I go to work at 8 every morning.)
他今天身体不舒服，没有去上班。 (He didn’t go to work today because he felt unwell.)
我下班以后直接坐地铁回家休息。 (I go straight home by MRT after work.)
周末的时候我常常回家看父母。 (I often go home to visit my parents on weekends.)

explanation: Leaving a place to spend time outside.
examples: 今天天气很好，我们一起出去走走吧。 (The weather is nice, let’s go out for a walk.)
他刚刚出去买东西，很快就回来。 (He just went out to buy something and will be back soon.)

explanation: Entering an indoor or enclosed space.
examples: 外面很冷，你快点进来坐一会儿。 (It’s cold outside, come in and sit for a while.)
老师叫学生一个一个地进来教室。 (The teacher asked students to come into the classroom one by one.)

explanation: Using the eyes to observe, watch, or read.
examples: 我晚上喜欢一个人在家看电影放松。 (I like watching movies at home alone at night.)
你可以帮我看看这个文件有没有问题吗？ (Can you help me check this document?)

explanation: Paying attention to sounds or spoken words.
examples: 我每天上下班的时候都会听音乐。 (I listen to music during my commute every day.)
请你认真听老师讲课的内容。 (Please listen carefully to the teacher.)
他会说三种语言，非常厉害。 (He can speak three languages, very impressive.)
我想跟你说一件很重要的事情。 (I want to tell you something important.)
我打算周末去商场买一些新衣服。 (I plan to buy some new clothes at the mall this weekend.)
她在网上买了一部新的手机。 (She bought a new phone online.)
这家店专门卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。 (This shop sells fresh fruits and vegetables.)
他在网上卖自己做的手工艺品。 (He sells handmade crafts online.)

explanation: Making something accessible by unsealing or switching on.
examples: 请帮我打开这个箱子看看里面有什么。 (Please help me open this box and see what’s inside.)
我每天早上都会打开电脑开始工作。 (I turn on my computer every morning to start work.)
你出门的时候记得把门关上锁好。 (Remember to close and lock the door when you leave.)
晚上睡觉前请把窗户关上。 (Please close the window before sleeping.)

explanation: The beginning of an action or event.
examples: 我们现在开始今天的会议讨论内容。 (Let’s start today’s meeting discussion now.)
电影还有十分钟就要开始了。 (The movie will start in ten minutes.)

explanation: The conclusion or completion of something.
examples: 会议结束以后大家一起去吃晚饭。 (After the meeting ends, let’s have dinner together.)
课程结束的时候老师给了很多作业。 (The teacher gave a lot of homework at the end of class.)

explanation: A state of physical or mental fatigue.
examples: 我今天走了很多路，感觉特别累。 (I walked a lot today and feel especially tired.)
工作了一整天以后，他已经很累了。 (After working all day, he is already tired.)

explanation: A feeling of joy or pleasure.
examples: 今天和朋友见面聊天让我很开心。 (Meeting and chatting with friends today made me happy.)
收到你的礼物我真的非常开心。 (I’m really happy to receive your gift.)

explanation: A polite greeting used in the morning.
examples: 早上好，你今天起得很早。 (Good morning, you got up early today.)
老师说：早上好，同学们。 (The teacher said: good morning, students.)

explanation: A polite greeting used in the evening.
examples: 晚上好，欢迎来到我们家。 (Good evening, welcome to our home.)
晚上好，你吃饭了吗？ (Good evening, have you eaten?)

explanation: Used when leaving or ending a conversation.
examples: 我要回家了，再见。 (I am going home, goodbye.)
下次见，再见。 (See you next time, goodbye.)
对不起，我迟到了。 (Sorry, I am late.)
对不起，我听错了。 (Sorry, I heard wrong.)

explanation: Used to respond kindly to an apology.
examples: 没关系，下次小心一点。 (It is okay, be more careful next time.)
你不用担心，没关系。 (Do not worry, it is okay.)

explanation: A polite word used before requests.
examples: 请坐在这里。 (Please sit here.)
请帮我看一下。 (Please help me take a look.)

explanation: A polite way to start a question.
examples: 请问，地铁站在哪里？ (Excuse me, where is the MRT station?)
请问，这个多少钱？ (May I ask, how much is this?)

explanation: Used to say something is fine or not serious.
examples: 我没事，你不用担心。 (I am fine, do not worry.)
没事，我们可以再试一次。 (No problem, we can try again.)

explanation: Used to identify or confirm something.
examples: 她是我的朋友。 (She is my friend.)
是，我明白了。 (Yes, I understand.)

explanation: Used to deny identity or confirmation.
examples: 这不是我的手机。 (This is not my phone.)
不是，我今天不去。 (No, I am not going today.)
我有一个问题。 (I have a question.)
附近有一家超市。 (There is a supermarket nearby.)

english: do not have; there is not
explanation: The negative form of having or existing.
examples: 我今天没有时间。 (I do not have time today.)
这里没有空位。 (There are no empty seats here.)

explanation: Used to express wanting or future intention.
examples: 我要一杯水。 (I want a cup of water.)
我明天要上班。 (I will work tomorrow.)
我想喝咖啡。 (I want to drink coffee.)
你在想什么？ (What are you thinking about?)

explanation: Used for learned ability or future likelihood.
examples: 我会说一点中文。 (I can speak a little Chinese.)
明天可能会下雨。 (It may rain tomorrow.)

explanation: Used for ability or permission in a situation.
examples: 我今天不能去。 (I cannot go today.)
你能帮我一下吗？ (Can you help me?)

explanation: Used to express what is proper or expected.
examples: 你应该早点休息。 (You should rest earlier.)
我们应该准时到。 (We should arrive on time.)
我需要你的帮助。 (I need your help.)
你需要买什么？ (What do you need to buy?)

explanation: Trying to find someone or something.
examples: 我在找我的钥匙。 (I am looking for my keys.)
你找谁？ (Who are you looking for?)

explanation: Used for giving or doing something for someone.
examples: 请给我一杯水。 (Please give me a cup of water.)
我给妈妈打电话。 (I call my mother.)
出门记得带手机。 (Remember to bring your phone when going out.)
我带你去车站。 (I will take you to the station.)

explanation: Using a tool, method, or object.
examples: 我用手机付款。 (I pay with my phone.)
这个怎么用？ (How do you use this?)

explanation: Performing an action or making something.
examples: 你在做什么？ (What are you doing?)
我今晚做饭。 (I will cook tonight.)
我去超市买东西。 (I am going to the supermarket to buy things.)
你要去哪里？ (Where are you going?)

explanation: Moving toward the speaker or place.
examples: 请明天再来。 (Please come again tomorrow.)
他今天会来吗？ (Will he come today?)
我已经到公司了。 (I have arrived at the office.)
你几点到家？ (What time do you get home?)
我们走路去学校。 (We walk to school.)
时间不早了，我要走了。 (It is late, I have to leave.)

explanation: Sitting down or taking a vehicle.
examples: 请坐。 (Please sit.)
我每天坐地铁上班。 (I take the MRT to work every day.)
我住在市中心。 (I live in the city center.)
你住几天？ (How many days will you stay?)
我晚上十一点睡觉。 (I sleep at 11 at night.)
孩子已经睡觉了。 (The child has already gone to sleep.)

explanation: Getting out of bed after sleeping.
examples: 我每天七点起床。 (I get up at seven every day.)
周末我想晚一点起床。 (I want to get up later on weekends.)
运动以后我要洗澡。 (I need to shower after exercise.)
我晚上洗澡。 (I shower at night.)
吃饭前要洗手。 (Wash your hands before eating.)
请先去洗手。 (Please wash your hands first.)

explanation: Putting clothes or shoes on the body.
examples: 今天很冷，要穿外套。 (It is cold today, wear a jacket.)
她穿红色的裙子。 (She is wearing a red dress.)
请帮我拿一下包。 (Please help me hold the bag.)
我去拿快递。 (I will go get the package.)
请把书放在桌子上。 (Please put the book on the table.)
手机不要放这里。 (Do not put the phone here.)

english: to send; to give as a gift
explanation: Delivering something or giving a gift.
examples: 我送你回家。 (I will take you home.)
他送我一本书。 (He gave me a book as a gift.)
你可以帮忙吗？ (Can you help?)
谢谢你今天帮忙。 (Thank you for helping today.)
我想问一个问题。 (I want to ask a question.)
你可以问老师。 (You can ask the teacher.)

explanation: Giving an answer to a question.
examples: 请回答我的问题。 (Please answer my question.)
他回答得很快。 (He answered quickly.)
我听不懂。 (I do not understand what I hear.)
你懂这个意思吗？ (Do you understand this meaning?)
我明白你的意思。 (I understand what you mean.)
现在明白了吗？ (Do you understand now?)

explanation: Knowing a person or recognizing something.
examples: 我认识她。 (I know her.)
你认识这个字吗？ (Do you recognize this character?)
你记得带钥匙。 (Remember to bring your keys.)
我不记得他的名字。 (I do not remember his name.)
我忘记带钱包了。 (I forgot to bring my wallet.)
别忘记明天的会议。 (Do not forget tomorrow’s meeting.)

explanation: Minutes, hours, days, or available time.
examples: 你现在有时间吗？ (Do you have time now?)
时间过得很快。 (Time passes quickly.)
今天星期二。 (Today is Tuesday.)
我今天很忙。 (I am busy today.)
明天我要上班。 (I have to work tomorrow.)
我们明天见。 (See you tomorrow.)
昨天我去了超市。 (I went to the supermarket yesterday.)
昨天晚上下雨了。 (It rained last night.)

explanation: The early part of the day.
examples: 我早上喝咖啡。 (I drink coffee in the morning.)
早上路上人很多。 (There are many people on the road in the morning.)
中午我们一起吃饭吧。 (Let us eat together at noon.)
我中午休息一小时。 (I rest for one hour at noon.)

explanation: The later part of the day.
examples: 晚上我想看电影。 (I want to watch a movie tonight.)
你晚上有空吗？ (Are you free tonight?)
周末我想休息。 (I want to rest on the weekend.)
你周末有什么计划？ (What plans do you have for the weekend?)
我家离学校很近。 (My home is close to school.)
她家有四个人。 (Her family has four people.)
孩子们去学校上课。 (The children go to school for class.)
学校附近有公园。 (There is a park near the school.)
我在这家公司工作。 (I work at this company.)
公司离地铁站很近。 (The office is close to the MRT station.)
他生病了，要去医院。 (He is sick and needs to go to the hospital.)
医院在前面。 (The hospital is ahead.)

explanation: A place where people buy things.
examples: 这家商店几点关门？ (What time does this store close?)
商店里有很多水果。 (There are many fruits in the store.)

explanation: A large store for food and daily items.
examples: 我去超市买牛奶。 (I go to the supermarket to buy milk.)
超市今天打折。 (The supermarket has discounts today.)

explanation: A place to eat meals, and sometimes a hotel depending on context.
examples: 这家饭店很好吃。 (This restaurant is good.)
我们晚上去饭店吃饭。 (We will eat at a restaurant tonight.)

explanation: A place to take buses, trains, or other transport.
examples: 车站离这里远吗？ (Is the station far from here?)
我在车站等你。 (I will wait for you at the station.)

explanation: An underground or urban train system.
examples: 我每天坐地铁上班。 (I take the MRT to work every day.)
地铁站在哪里？ (Where is the subway station?)
我坐公交车去学校。 (I take the bus to school.)
公交车来了。 (The bus is here.)
下雨了，我们坐出租车吧。 (It is raining, let us take a taxi.)
出租车在门口等。 (The taxi is waiting at the door.)

explanation: A phone used for calls, messages, and apps.
examples: 我的手机没电了。 (My phone is out of battery.)
请不要一直看手机。 (Please do not keep looking at your phone.)

explanation: An electronic device for work, study, and browsing.
examples: 我用电脑工作。 (I use a computer for work.)
这台电脑有点慢。 (This computer is a little slow.)

explanation: A small object used to open a lock.
examples: 我忘记带钥匙了。 (I forgot to bring my keys.)
钥匙在桌子上。 (The key is on the table.)

explanation: A small case for money and cards.
examples: 我的钱包不见了。 (My wallet is missing.)
钱包里没有现金。 (There is no cash in the wallet.)
我想买新衣服。 (I want to buy new clothes.)
这些衣服很干净。 (These clothes are very clean.)
这双鞋子很舒服。 (These shoes are comfortable.)
请把鞋子放门口。 (Please put your shoes at the door.)
请给我一杯水。 (Please give me a cup of water.)
水太热了。 (The water is too hot.)

explanation: A common drink made from coffee beans.
examples: 我早上喝咖啡。 (I drink coffee in the morning.)
这杯咖啡不甜。 (This coffee is not sweet.)

explanation: A common drink made from tea leaves.
examples: 你喜欢喝茶吗？ (Do you like drinking tea?)
这茶很好喝。 (This tea tastes good.)
饭好了，来吃吧。 (The meal is ready, come eat.)
我喜欢吃米饭。 (I like eating rice.)

explanation: Long thin food made from flour or starch.
examples: 我中午吃面条。 (I eat noodles at noon.)
这碗面条很好吃。 (This bowl of noodles is delicious.)
我每天吃一个苹果。 (I eat an apple every day.)
这个苹果很甜。 (This apple is sweet.)
孩子喜欢吃香蕉。 (The child likes eating bananas.)
香蕉在桌子上。 (The banana is on the table.)

explanation: A common food used in many meals.
examples: 早餐我吃两个鸡蛋。 (I eat two eggs for breakfast.)
鸡蛋很新鲜。 (The eggs are fresh.)
我去超市买牛奶。 (I go to the supermarket to buy milk.)
这瓶牛奶快过期了。 (This bottle of milk will expire soon.)
今天很热。 (Today is hot.)
这杯水太热了。 (This cup of water is too hot.)
外面很冷。 (It is cold outside.)
我想喝冷水。 (I want to drink cold water.)
这个菜很好吃。 (This dish is delicious.)
那家饭店的面条好吃。 (The noodles at that restaurant are good.)
这杯茶很好喝。 (This tea tastes good.)
咖啡好喝吗？ (Does the coffee taste good?)
这件衣服很漂亮。 (This piece of clothing is beautiful.)
她的家很漂亮。 (Her home is beautiful.)
这个手机太贵了。 (This phone is too expensive.)
这里的东西不贵。 (Things here are not expensive.)
这个苹果很便宜。 (This apple is cheap.)
这家店的衣服便宜。 (The clothes in this shop are inexpensive.)
地铁很快。 (The MRT is fast.)
快一点，我们要迟到了。 (Hurry up, we will be late.)
这台电脑很慢。 (This computer is slow.)
请说慢一点。 (Please speak a little slower.)
学校离我家很远。 (The school is far from my home.)
车站远吗？ (Is the station far?)
公司离地铁站很近。 (The office is near the MRT station.)
我家很近。 (My home is nearby.)
我今天很忙。 (I am very busy today.)
你最近忙不忙？ (Have you been busy recently?)
你现在有空吗？ (Are you free now?)
这里有空位。 (There is an empty seat here.)
我买了新手机。 (I bought a new phone.)
这是我的新朋友。 (This is my new friend.)
这件衣服有点旧。 (This piece of clothing is a little old.)
旧电脑还能用。 (The old computer can still be used.)
这个房间很大。 (This room is big.)
雨下得很大。 (The rain is heavy.)
这个包太小了。 (This bag is too small.)
我有一个小问题。 (I have a small question.)
今天人很多。 (There are many people today.)
请多喝水。 (Please drink more water.)
这里人很少。 (There are few people here.)
我今天吃得很少。 (I ate very little today.)

explanation: Used to ask method or manner.
examples: 这个字怎么读？ (How do you read this character?)
去车站怎么走？ (How do I get to the station?)
你在哪里？ (Where are you?)
洗手间在哪里？ (Where is the restroom?)
你什么时候下班？ (When do you get off work?)
会议什么时候开始？ (When does the meeting start?)

explanation: Used to ask about a person.
examples: 他是谁？ (Who is he?)
你在等谁？ (Who are you waiting for?)
你喜欢哪个？ (Which one do you like?)
哪个是你的包？ (Which one is your bag?)

explanation: Used to ask small numbers or time.
examples: 现在几点？ (What time is it now?)
你家有几个人？ (How many people are in your family?)

explanation: A common degree word before adjectives.
examples: 今天很热。 (Today is very hot.)
她很开心。 (She is very happy.)

explanation: Used to say something is the same for another person or thing.
examples: 我也喜欢咖啡。 (I also like coffee.)
他也是学生。 (He is also a student.)

explanation: Used for all members of a group.
examples: 我们都在这里。 (We are all here.)
这些东西都很便宜。 (These things are all cheap.)

explanation: Used for continuation or adding something.
examples: 他还在工作。 (He is still working.)
我还想买苹果。 (I also want to buy apples.)

explanation: A common word for sequence, emphasis, or sooner-than-expected action.
examples: 我马上就来。 (I will come right away.)
到家以后就休息。 (Rest after getting home.)
我想去，但是没有时间。 (I want to go, but I do not have time.)
这个好看，但是太贵。 (This looks good, but it is too expensive.)
今天下雨，所以我不出去。 (It is raining today, so I am not going out.)
我很累，所以想睡觉。 (I am tired, so I want to sleep.)
如果下雨，我们就坐地铁。 (If it rains, we will take the MRT.)
如果你有空，请给我电话。 (If you are free, please call me.)
我和朋友去吃饭。 (I go eat with a friend.)
我要苹果和香蕉。 (I want apples and bananas.)

explanation: Used for location or ongoing action.
examples: 我在家。 (I am at home.)
他在看电视。 (He is watching TV.)

explanation: Indicates inside a place or thing.
examples: 手机在包里。 (The phone is in the bag.)
房间里有人。 (There is someone in the room.)

explanation: Indicates on top of something or above.
examples: 书在桌子上。 (The book is on the table.)
我在网上买东西。 (I buy things online.)
鞋子在桌子下。 (The shoes are under the table.)
请往下看。 (Please look down.)

explanation: Refers to a person or people.
examples: 这里有很多人。 (There are many people here.)
他是一个很好的人。 (He is a very good person.)
那个男人是我的老师。 (That man is my teacher.)
门口有一个男人在等你。 (There is a man waiting for you at the door.)
那个女人在买水果。 (That woman is buying fruit.)
她是一个很忙的女人。 (She is a very busy woman.)
孩子在房间里睡觉。 (The child is sleeping in the room.)
这个孩子很喜欢苹果。 (This child really likes apples.)
我爸爸今天不上班。 (My dad is not working today.)
爸爸在厨房做饭。 (Dad is cooking in the kitchen.)
我妈妈喜欢喝茶。 (My mom likes drinking tea.)
妈妈给我打电话。 (Mom called me.)
我哥哥在公司工作。 (My older brother works at a company.)
哥哥今天回家吃饭。 (Older brother is coming home to eat today.)
我姐姐是老师。 (My older sister is a teacher.)
姐姐带我去买衣服。 (Older sister took me to buy clothes.)
我弟弟还在学校。 (My younger brother is still at school.)
弟弟喜欢看电视。 (Younger brother likes watching TV.)
我妹妹想喝牛奶。 (My younger sister wants to drink milk.)
妹妹在房间里听音乐。 (Younger sister is listening to music in the room.)
老师在教我们中文。 (The teacher is teaching us Chinese.)
我想问老师一个问题。 (I want to ask the teacher a question.)

explanation: A person who studies at school or in a class.
examples: 她是大学生。 (She is a university student.)
学生们都在教室里。 (The students are all in the classroom.)

explanation: A person who works with you.
examples: 我和同事一起吃午饭。 (I eat lunch with my coworker.)
这个同事很会帮忙。 (This coworker is very helpful.)
这个房间很干净。 (This room is very clean.)
我的手机在房间里。 (My phone is in the room.)
妈妈在厨房做饭。 (Mom is cooking in the kitchen.)
厨房里有很多东西。 (There are many things in the kitchen.)
请问，洗手间在哪里？ (Excuse me, where is the restroom?)
洗手间在前面。 (The restroom is ahead.)

explanation: The entrance to a room or building.
examples: 请把门关上。 (Please close the door.)
他在门口等我。 (He is waiting for me at the door.)

explanation: An opening with glass in a wall.
examples: 请打开窗户。 (Please open the window.)
窗户外面下雨了。 (It is raining outside the window.)

explanation: Furniture with a flat top for putting things on.
examples: 书在桌子上。 (The book is on the table.)
请把电脑放在桌子上。 (Please put the computer on the desk.)
这把椅子很舒服。 (This chair is comfortable.)
请坐在那把椅子上。 (Please sit on that chair.)

explanation: A written or printed work for reading.
examples: 我喜欢看书。 (I like reading books.)
这本书很有意思。 (This book is interesting.)

explanation: A device or program for watching shows.
examples: 我晚上看电视。 (I watch TV at night.)
电视在客厅里。 (The TV is in the living room.)

explanation: A film people watch for entertainment.
examples: 这部电影很好看。 (This movie is very good.)
周末我们去看电影吧。 (Let us watch a movie this weekend.)

explanation: Sounds arranged for listening and enjoyment.
examples: 我喜欢听音乐。 (I like listening to music.)
这首音乐很好听。 (This piece of music sounds good.)

explanation: A phone or a phone call.
examples: 我给你打电话。 (I will call you.)
电话响了。 (The phone rang.)
我收到你的消息了。 (I received your message.)
有消息请告诉我。 (Please tell me if there is news.)

explanation: A picture taken with a camera or phone.
examples: 这张照片很好看。 (This photo looks good.)
请给我发一张照片。 (Please send me a photo.)
我没有带钱。 (I did not bring money.)
这个要多少钱？ (How much money does this cost?)

explanation: A card used for payment, access, or identification.
examples: 我可以用卡付款吗？ (Can I pay by card?)
这张卡不能用了。 (This card cannot be used anymore.)

explanation: Physical money such as notes and coins.
examples: 你有现金吗？ (Do you have cash?)
这里不能用现金。 (Cash cannot be used here.)

explanation: A ticket for transport, movies, or events.
examples: 我买了两张电影票。 (I bought two movie tickets.)
请把票给我看一下。 (Please show me the ticket.)

explanation: A place where planes arrive and leave.
examples: 我们几点去机场？ (What time are we going to the airport?)
机场离这里很远。 (The airport is far from here.)
我坐火车去那个城市。 (I take the train to that city.)
火车几点到？ (What time does the train arrive?)

explanation: A vehicle that flies in the air.
examples: 飞机晚点了。 (The airplane is delayed.)
我明天坐飞机。 (I will take a plane tomorrow.)

explanation: A road or a route to a place.
examples: 这条路很长。 (This road is very long.)
去车站的路怎么走？ (How do I get to the station?)
洗手间在左边。 (The restroom is on the left.)
请往左边走。 (Please walk to the left.)
商店在右边。 (The shop is on the right.)
请坐在我右边。 (Please sit on my right side.)

explanation: The area in front or ahead.
examples: 车站就在前面。 (The station is just ahead.)
请看前面。 (Please look at the front.)
他坐在我后面。 (He sits behind me.)
厨房在房子后面。 (The kitchen is behind the house.)
超市在学校旁边。 (The supermarket is next to the school.)
请坐在我旁边。 (Please sit next to me.)

explanation: Something asked or something that needs solving.
examples: 我有一个问题。 (I have a question.)
这个问题不难。 (This problem is not difficult.)

explanation: An event, matter, or thing to deal with.
examples: 我有事情要做。 (I have something to do.)
这件事情很重要。 (This matter is very important.)

explanation: A word used to identify a person or thing.
examples: 你的名字是什么？ (What is your name?)
我忘记了他的名字。 (I forgot his name.)

explanation: The condition outside, such as hot, cold, rain, or sun.
examples: 今天天气很好。 (The weather is good today.)
明天天气怎么样？ (How is the weather tomorrow?)
外面下雨了。 (It is raining outside.)
今天的雨很大。 (The rain is heavy today.)

explanation: The bright star that gives light during the day.
examples: 今天太阳很大。 (The sun is strong today.)
太阳出来了。 (The sun came out.)
你吃药了吗？ (Have you taken medicine?)
医生给我开了药。 (The doctor prescribed medicine for me.)
你身体怎么样？ (How is your health?)
身体不舒服就去医院。 (Go to the hospital if your body feels unwell.)

explanation: To become ill or be sick.
examples: 我今天生病了。 (I am sick today.)
他生病了，所以没有上班。 (He is sick, so he did not go to work.)
